stage0035_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed: a unit resembling Neo Zeon is approaching」

stage0035_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$ called it, huh...!」

stage0035_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All right...!
　Get our units launched too!」

stage0035_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You know the terms, $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$.
　Whoever nabs the white one wins」

stage0035_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't rush for glory and disgrace yourself,
　$$ギュネイ・ガス$$, or waste the Institute's money」

stage0035_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$クェス$$
「Hey... aren't you joining the game?」

stage0035_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Not interested.
　I'm only carrying out my mission
　of striking down $c」

stage0035_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$クェス$$
「I knew it, you're... someone who gets it」

stage0035_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$クェス$$
「Guess you could call it a Newtype thing?」

stage0035_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm an Enhanced Human, same as $$ギュネイ$$」

stage0035_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$クェス$$
「That doesn't matter.
　What matters is whether you get it or not,
　and I think you're someone who gets it」

stage0035_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm... $$クェス$$ Air.
　Nice to meet you, Lieutenant $$マリーダ$$」

stage0035_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$クェス$$...
　Aren't you scared, out on the battlefield?」

stage0035_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$クェス$$
「...Dunno.
　But the colonel went to the trouble
　of getting me a mobile suit」

stage0035_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$クェス$$
「I have to live up to his expectations」

stage0035_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「So the Supreme Commander is your master...」

stage0035_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「No... don't worry about it」

stage0035_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$, I'll keep an eye on $$クェス$$.
　Do as you like」

stage0035_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Appreciate it, $$マリーダ$$.
　I owe you one」

stage0035_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Enhanced Humans getting chummy...
　How distasteful」

stage0035_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Figures, the enemy came after the Unicorn」

stage0035_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Hopefully this gives us at least some idea
　of Neo Zeon's strategy...」

stage0035_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$,
　I'm counting on you to cover $$バナージ$$」

stage0035_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, protect the Unicorn
　while intercepting the enemy force!」

stage0035_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Also, capture the enemy leader's unit if you can.
　I want whatever intel on Neo Zeon we can get」

stage0035_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The four-wing that hit Industrial 7 is here too...」

stage0035_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（Somehow, I just know...
　$$クェス$$ is in there...）

stage0035_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Confirmed: the enemy force has been wiped out」

stage0035_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Captain!
　How do you intend to take responsibility!?」

stage0035_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$オットー$$
「I'm already thinking about it!」

stage0035_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Tch!
　$$アンジェロ$$'ll be lording it over me again!」

stage0035_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Watch me, $c...!
　I'm not a man who ends like this!」

stage0035_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「All talk, no bite, $$ギュネイ$$.
　Just Director $$ナナイ$$'s pricey toy, after all」

stage0035_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Here I come, split-horn...!
　I'll capture you and declare my victory to him!」

stage0035_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it!
　I can't laugh at $$アンジェロ$$ after this!」

stage0035_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Watch me, $c...!
　I'm not a man who ends like this!」

stage0035_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't push too far, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0035_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I catch him,
　I might learn Captain $$クワトロ$$'s true intent...」

stage0035_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$!
　Come here just to be knocked down!?」

stage0035_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is bad...!
　He has lost consciousness!」

stage0035_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Careless, $$カミーユ$$.
　As you are now, you're no match for me」

stage0035_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll be taking this mobile suit and its pilot.
　...Fall back, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$」

stage0035_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
（Damn it...!
　Show up late and take all the credit!）

stage0035_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$赤木$$
「Showing up at a time like this!」

stage0035_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$デュオ$$
「It's an unmanned unit!
　No use complaining about it!」

stage0035_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept the UG!
　Just focus on getting through this for now!」

stage0035_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, you cover $$ハサウェイ$$」

stage0035_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Impossible...!
　That I'd fall behind an Enhanced Human!」

stage0035_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Unforgivable, $c...!
　I'll wipe out this disgrace, mark my words!」

stage0035_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Pathetic, $$アンジェロ$$.
　You're a disgrace to the Guard's name」

stage0035_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Now if I capture the split-horn, it's perfect!
　Here I go!」

stage0035_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Unbelievable...!
　That I'd make the same mistake as $$ギュネイ$$!」

stage0035_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Unforgivable, $c...!
　I'll wipe out this disgrace, mark my words!」

stage0035_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't push too far, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0035_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I catch him,
　I might learn Captain $$クワトロ$$'s true intent...」

stage0035_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What a fool!
　Come here just to be knocked down!?」

stage0035_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is bad...!
　He has lost consciousness!」

stage0035_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Careless, $$カミーユ$$.
　As you are now, you're no match for me」

stage0035_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll be taking this mobile suit and its pilot.
　...Fall back, $$アンジェロ$$」

stage0035_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Showing up at a time like this!」

stage0035_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「It's an unmanned unit!
　No use complaining about it!」

stage0035_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept the UG!
　Just focus on getting through this for now!」

stage0035_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, you cover $$ハサウェイ$$」

stage0035_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm fine, $$ギュネイ$$!
　I can fall back on my own!」

stage0035_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Are you all right, $$クェス$$!」

stage0035_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm okay, $$マリーダ$$!
　This much, I can fall back on my own!」

stage0035_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$クェス$$
「I've been hit...!?
　But this much, I can fall back on my own!」

stage0035_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What is that $$ジェガン$$!
　Who's piloting it!?」

stage0035_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$クェス$$
「That mobile suit!
　It's after me!?」

stage0035_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Stop it, $$クェス$$!
　You can't stay with Neo Zeon!」

stage0035_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$シャア$$ is trying to start a war!
　You mustn't help him do that!」

stage0035_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$クェス$$
「Don't act like you understand!
　$$ハサウェイ$$, so you're like that too!」

stage0035_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Acting on your own like that!!」

stage0035_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$!
　Cover $$ハサウェイ$$!」

stage0035_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Captain $$クワトロ$$...
　Did you become $$シャア$$ again
　just to do this...!）

stage0035_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$!
　Think about surviving, right now!」

stage0035_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カツ$$
「You want to save $$クェス$$, right!?
　Then you can't die!!」

stage0035_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Do you understand, $$シャア$$...!
　If you keep doing this,
　the tragedy will repeat itself!）

stage0035_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（To go this far, right in front of Lady $$ミネバ$$...!）

stage0035_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$, falling back!」

stage0035_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$オードリー$$
（I'm sorry, $$マリーダ$$...
　You must be pushing yourself
　to save me...）

stage0035_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$オードリー$$
（But now that $$シャア$$ has risen,
　I want to find what I can do...
　to bring this war to an end...）

stage0035_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Out of my way, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$!
　I've no business with you today!」

stage0035_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Though you, shaken by
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$'s return, are no match for me!」

stage0035_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That man... why is he so
　fixated on $$カミーユ$$!?」

stage0035_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The man $$シャア・アズナブル$$ has hopes for!
　Beating him would prove my strength!」

stage0035_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「But today my target is... Split-Horn!
　You!!」

stage0035_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Pilot of the Split-Horn!
　Surrender quietly!」

stage0035_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That guy... what's he talking about!?」

stage0035_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't listen to the enemy, $$バナージ$$!
　He's coming after you!」

stage0035_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You ignored my warning, so you'll pay!」

stage0035_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I owed you all from
　our earlier battles too!」

stage0035_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That mobile suit...!
　Is that $$クェス$$ piloting it!?」

stage0035_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$クェス$$
「As expected, $$カミーユ$$!
　You can tell it's me!?」

stage0035_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What are you doing!
　Do you even understand what you're doing!?」

stage0035_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$クェス$$
「You don't have to say it like that!
　The Colonel understands me just fine!」

stage0035_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$クェス$$
「I hate you when you're like that!
　I'm telling the Colonel on you!」

stage0035_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（Now that I think about it, it all started
　with that fight against the white mobile suit...）

stage0035_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（Then I'll settle this with my own hands...!
　And for Master's sake as well, I'll
　save Lady $$ミネバ$$!）

stage0035_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's right!
　The Colonel gave me this mobile suit!」

stage0035_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Get out of that unit right now, $$クェス$$!
　Before things go too far to fix!」

stage0035_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$クェス$$
「What are you talking about, $$アムロ$$!?」

stage0035_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Why can't you see the danger of arming
　a child who doesn't even understand, $$シャア$$!?」

stage0035_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$クェス$$
「You're the one who doesn't get it, $$アムロ$$!
　The Colonel already treats me as capable!」

stage0035_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$クェス$$
「I knew it, $$アムロ$$ won't do!
　Only the Colonel understands me!」

stage0035_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$オットー$$
「The four-winged one is coming!
　Hurry and intercept!!」

stage0035_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（I can feel it...!
　Lady $$ミネバ$$ really is on that ship...!）

stage0035_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（But what is this feeling...?
　I sense a strange calm from Lady $$ミネバ$$'s heart...）

stage0035_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シン$$
「This guy...!
　The one who's been stalking $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0035_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「And you think you're some knight guarding $$カミーユ$$!?」

stage0035_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$シン$$
「He's my precious friend!
　And right now, he needs help!」

stage0035_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シン$$
「If you're after $$カミーユ$$, I'll be your foe!
　I will protect him, no matter what!!」

stage0035_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（$$クェス$$... I swear I'll bring you back...!）

stage0035_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（I won't let myself die before then!
　Even if my opponent is $$シャア$$!）
